text: {"lessons":["I should base trades on each stock’s outlook and portfolio risk, not sell winners just to lock in gains or hold losers to avoid realizing pain.","Selling Stock D and E at large losses reminded me to reassess declining positions early and use clear criteria for when the investment case has changed.","Frequent account checking can encourage reactive trading; I should follow a disciplined plan and consider diversification rather than letting short-term price moves drive decisions."]}
